title: The homeodomain of Oct4 is a dimeric binder of methylated CpG elements.
authors: Tan, Daisylyn Senna; Cheung, Shun Lai; Gao, Ya; Weinbuch, Maike; Hu, Haoqing; Shi, Liyang; Ti, Shih-Chieh; Hutchins, Andrew P; Cojocaru, Vlad; Jauch, Ralf
one_liner_zh: 该文结合结构分析与分子动力学模拟，揭示Oct4通过POU同源域以二聚体形式特异性结合甲基化CpG回文元件，属于TF-DNA互作机制建模的高匹配研究。
abstract: Oct4 is essential to maintain pluripotency and has a pivotal role in establishing the germline. Its DNA-binding POU domain was recently found to bind motifs with methylated CpG elements normally associated with epigenetic silencing. However, the mode of binding and the consequences of this capability has remained unclear. Here, we show that Oct4 binds to a compact palindromic DNA element with a methylated CpG core (CpGpal) in alternative states of pluripotency and during cellular reprogramming towards induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs). During cellular reprogramming, typical Oct4 bound enhancers are uniformly demethylated, with the prominent exception of the CpGpal sites where DNA methylation is often maintained. We demonstrate that Oct4 cooperatively binds the CpGpal element as a homodimer, which contrasts with the ectoderm-expressed POU factor Brn2. Indeed, binding to CpGpal is Oct4-specific as other POU factors expressed in somatic cells avoid this element. Binding assays combined with structural analyses and molecular dynamic simulations show that dimeric Oct4-binding to CpGpal is driven by the POU-homeodomain whilst the POU-specific domain is detached from DNA. Collectively, we report that Oct4 exerts parts of its regulatory function in the context of methylated DNA through a DNA recognition mechanism that solely relies on its homeodomain.
abstract_zh: Oct4对维持多能性至关重要，并在生殖系的建立中发挥关键作用。其DNA结合的POU结构域最近被发现能够结合通常与表观遗传沉默相关的甲基化CpG元件。然而，这种结合的模式及其能力的后果仍不清楚。在此，我们展示Oct4在多能性的替代状态及向诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）的细胞重编程过程中，结合一个具有甲基化CpG核心（CpGpal）的紧凑回文DNA元件。在细胞重编程期间，典型的Oct4结合增强子被均匀去甲基化，但CpGpal位点除外，这些位点的DNA甲基化通常得以维持。我们证明Oct4以同源二聚体形式协同结合CpGpal元件，这与外胚层表达的POU因子Brn2形成对比。确实，对CpGpal的结合是Oct4特异性的，因为体细胞中表达的其他POU因子避免该元件。结合实验结合结构分析和分子动力学模拟表明，Oct4二聚体对CpGpal的结合由POU同源结构域驱动，而POU特异性结构域与DNA脱离。总体而言，我们报告Oct4在甲基化DNA背景下通过一种仅依赖其同源结构域的DNA识别机制发挥其部分调控功能。
